originalTitle: At least one person dead in California wildfire allegedly sparked by chainsaw
summary: Police arrested Herbert Wayne Smith, 65, in connection with the Gann fire, which has burned more than 15 sq miles in Calaveras county
content: At least one person has died in a wildfire burning in the foothills of California’s Sierra Nevada mountain range that officials believed was sparked by a man using a chainsaw. Police arrested Herbert Wayne Smith, 65, in connection with the Gann fire, which has destroyed seven buildings, scorched more than 15 sq miles in Calaveras county and killed a well-known dog breeder in the town of Angels Camp. In an interview with KCRA, Smith told reporters he did not mean to spark the fire. Monday was his birthday, he said, and he had been using machinery to cut scraps in order collect money for a celebratory meal with his wife. “I’m so sorry for everything that’s happened,” Smith told the news station. “This is going to destroy my life, one way or another.” Officials allege that Smith is responsible for “recklessly causing” the blaze on Monday while “operating equipment capable of producing sparks” without clearing flammable vegetation as required, according to the California department of forestry and fire protection. Prosecutors will determine whether to file criminal charges. In 2018, Smith was charged with igniting another fire, KCRA reported, and was accused of “willfully and unlawfully [setting] fire to any forest, brush, or other flammable material which is on any land that is not his own, or under his legal control, without the permission of the owner, lessee, or agent of the owner or lessee of the land”. He pleaded no contest and received a sentence of 36 months’ probation. As of Friday morning, the Gann fire had burned more than 10,000 acres and was about 40% contained. Investigators will determine whether the fire contributed to the death of the person found in a burned home near the town of Angels Camp, the Calaveras county sheriff’s office said. Friends have identified the victim as Susan Solari and a neighbor told CBS Sacramento that she refused to leave her dogs. “I told them she was there, that her dogs were there and she couldn’t get her dogs out,” Joan Wilson told the outlet. “She wasn’t going to leave them.” The Gann fire comes amid a grueling fire season in the American west. Three major fires have continued to burn around the city of Spokane in north-eastern Washington and have destroyed at least 800 buildings. A 37-year-old man has been arrested for allegedly sparking one of the fires, and court documents accuse him of studying how to maximize the blaze’s destruction. No deaths have been reported in Washington. Officials reported on Thursday that cooler temperatures and calmer winds have allowed firefighters to make progress. Associated Press contributed reporting
chineseTitle: 加州山火据称由电锯引发 至少一人死亡
chineseSummary: 警方逮捕了 65 岁的赫伯特·韦恩·史密斯 (Herbert Wayne Smith)，他涉嫌与卡拉维拉斯县江恩火灾有关，该火灾已烧毁超过 15 平方英里
chineseContent: 加利福尼亚州内华达山脉山麓发生的野火已造成至少一人死亡，官员们认为这场野火是由一名男子使用电锯引发的。警方逮捕了 65 岁的赫伯特·韦恩·史密斯 (Herbert Wayne Smith)，罪名是与江恩大火有关。这场大火烧毁了七座建筑物，烧毁了卡拉维拉斯县超过 15 平方英里的土地，并杀死了天使营 (Angels Camp) 镇的一位著名养狗人。史密斯在接受 KCRA 采访时告诉记者，他无意引发火灾。他说，周一是他的生日，他一直在用机器切割废料，以便筹集与妻子一起庆祝的餐费。 “我对发生的一切感到非常抱歉，”史密斯告诉新闻台。 “这会以某种方式毁掉我的生活。”据加州林业和消防部门称，官员们称，史密斯在没有按要求清除易燃植被的情况下，“操作能够产生火花的设备”时，“鲁莽地引发”了火灾。检察官将决定是否提出刑事指控。据 KCRA 报道，2018 年，史密斯被指控点燃另一场火灾，并被指控“未经土地所有者、承租人或土地所有者或承租人代理人的许可，故意非法[放火]不属于他自己或在他合法控制下的任何土地上的任何森林、灌木丛或其他易燃材料”。他没有提出抗辩，并被判处 36 个月缓刑。截至周五上午，江恩大火已烧毁超过 10,000 英亩土地，约 40% 的面积已得到控制。卡拉维拉斯县治安官办公室表示，调查人员将确定火灾是否导致天使营镇附近一处被烧毁的房屋中发现的人死亡。好友有身份
